title: Compatible finite-descent sections have preimages on geometric stalks
statement: Let $f:X\prime\to X$ be finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] and surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism], and $G$ a sheaf of sets on $X_{\acute et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]. Put $A=f_*f^{-1}G$ and let $\eta:G\to A$ be the unit [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units]. If $s\prime\in A(X)$ has equal comparison pullbacks to $X\prime\times_X X\prime$ [def-pc-fibre-product], then for every geometric point $x:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$ [def-weil-geometric-point] and every lift $z$ of $x$ to the identity étale object, there exists $a\in G_x$ with $\eta_x(a)=[s\prime]_z\in A_x$; stalks and germs are those of [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. This asserts only membership in the image of the stalk map, not the existence of a section preimage on any neighbourhood.

proof.text: Construct each coordinate bijection using etaleSetInverseImageStalkGerm. Represent a germ of G by a section using Point.toPresheafFiber_jointly_surjective, then apply germ naturality and colimit.ι_pre to prove that the stalk unit has diagonal coordinates (private descent_coordinate).
Surjectivity gives a point of X prime above the image of x. Finite geometric-point lifting gives a lift t over the same algebraically closed field.
Apply the coordinate-constancy theorem to the compatible section and the coordinate bijections with their diagonal formula. Every coordinate of its germ equals the t-coordinate.

Take the t-coordinate as the desired germ a. Apply injectivity of the finite pushforward stalk product map, then injectivity of each coordinate bijection. The diagonal formula and coordinate constancy prove equality of the stalk unit of a with the original germ.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 09Z2, geometric stalk and diagonal argument; Remark 09Z3 (set-valued version)

from.place: proof steps 1–9: the preimage on each geometric stalk

theorem finiteSurjectiveSetDescent_compatible_germ_lifts
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X' ⟶ X) [IsFinite f] [Surjective f]
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) :
    ∀ s' : ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback f).obj G).obj.obj
          (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f).obj
            (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X)))),
        etaleSetDescentComparison f (pullback.fst f f) G (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X)) s' =
          eqToHom (congrArg
            (fun k : pullback f f ⟶ X ↦ ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback k).obj G).obj.obj
              (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ k).obj
                (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X))))) (pullback.condition (f := f) (g := f)).symm)
            (etaleSetDescentComparison f (pullback.snd f f) G
              (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X)) s') →
          ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
            (x : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X)
            (z : (Scheme.pointSmallEtale x).fiber.obj (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X))),
            ∃ a : (Scheme.pointSmallEtale x).sheafFiber.obj G,
              (Scheme.pointSmallEtale x).sheafFiber.map
                ((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
              (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f) (Type (u + 1))
              (X.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
              (X'.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).unit.app G) a =
                (Scheme.pointSmallEtale x).toPresheafFiber (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X)) z
                  ((f.Etale.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (u + 1))
                    X.smallEtaleTopology X'.smallEtaleTopology).obj
                      ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback f).obj G)).obj s'
